title: The Korean War
text: The Korean War (1950–1953) was a war between North Korea (supported by China and the Soviet Union) and South Korea (supported by the United Nations, primarily the United States). It began on June 25, 1950, when North Korean forces invaded South Korea. The war reached a stalemate near the original 38th parallel boundary after UN forces pushed back North Korean advances and Chinese forces entered the conflict. An armistice was signed on July 27, 1953, ending active combat but not officially ending the war, as no peace treaty was ever signed. The war resulted in approximately 5 million casualties. Korea remains divided along the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ) near the 38th parallel.
